run_fix_state_cli: run the fix_state script on checkpoint files to add missing task state metadata
run_add_task_state_av_hubert: run add_task_state on an av_hubert checkpoint to load dictionaries and set fine_tuning to False
run_add_task_state_w2v_finetune: run add_task_state on a w2v checkpoint to load dictionaries, target dictionary, and BPE tokenizer
review_add_task_state: review the add_task_state function that patches fairseq checkpoint files with task state and dictionaries
summarize_fix_state: summarize the fix_state module that fixes missing task_state in av_hubert and w2v checkpoint files
